title: Pure Mist Peach 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Peach captures the rich, smooth and juicy taste of ripe Peaches for a sunny, sweet and refreshing vape. This simple yet satisfying flavour is ideal for vapers who enjoy sweet, natural fruit blends with a long finish. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers a variety of VG/PG ratios. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour with discreet vapour. Crafted for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Peach is made in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
